title: Biological Components, Harvest, Embodied Modification & Lineage Integration
objective: Integrate accepted source-authored anatomy/components, harvest outputs, biological material provenance, body-location compatibility and donor/source lineage into systemic projections and consequence bindings without creating a second anatomy, crafting, cooking, alchemy, medicine, research, economy, Character, Species/Form or DPL modification runtime.
acceptance: Biological component bindings reference exact source-authored anatomy/component definitions and owner versions; absent organs/components remain unresolved rather than invented.
Component condition, damage and availability projections preserve owner authority and exact provenance.
Harvest method, quality and conservation-safe outputs are bound only from authored source rules; absent yields remain unresolved.
Biological material retains donor/source lineage and exact source Event/version attribution through downstream adapters.
Crafting, cooking, alchemy, medicine, research and economy integrations consume accepted biological-material outputs without MSWI recreating their owner runtimes.
Graft, implant, symbiote and prosthetic bindings require explicit body-location/interface compatibility and never infer absent compatibility.
Grant, removal, retained-state and reversal behavior remains attributable and preserves immutable Event/history evidence.
Identity, memory, psychological and social consequences execute only from explicit authored rules; absent donor effects remain unresolved.
Permission filtering precedes component/lineage counts, search, diagnostics, explanation, AI context and export.
Blocking workflows remain semantic/textual, keyboard-capable, provider-off, optional-AI independent and paid-cloud independent.
boundaries: MSWI-01, MSWI-03, MSWI-04 and MSWI-06 plus all upstream completed programs remain sealed.
Source anatomy/component owners retain canonical anatomy, condition and availability state.
DPL-13 and Character/Species/Form owners retain embodied modification, body and identity authority; MSWI-07 owns integration bindings only.
Crafting/cooking/alchemy/medicine/research/economy owners retain their own processing and outcome authority.
Absent organs, yields, compatibility rules, donor effects, identity/memory/psychological/social consequences remain unresolved and may not be inferred.
MSWI-14 and later MSWI tranches remain unauthorized until canonical MSWI-07 closeout.
next_action: Establish causal RED for the public MSWI-07 biological component/harvest/lineage/embodied-modification seam, then implement only bounded source-authored component, harvest provenance, compatibility, lineage, lifecycle and explicit-consequence behavior.

last_material_progress.evidence: Owner Continue governed-started MSWI-07 from completed_verified MSWI-06.
